name: Meta Muse Free
free_limit: Free personal AI agent for web, iOS and Android with a usage allowance that refreshes after the free limit is reached; Meta does not publish a fixed free token quota on its product overview.
watch_out: Availability is region-gated; Meta has announced launches in the US, Japan and Singapore, while other accounts may encounter a waitlist. Higher usage requires a paid subscription. One-time referral token bonuses are separate from the ongoing free allowance and are not included in this listing.
